doc.toml:
reflex = 1
description = "Download a file."
effect = "write"
confirm = "Download {url}?"
run = "download.mts"

[needs]
reads  = ["{place}", "/etc/hosts"]
writes = ["{to}", "~/Downloads"]
hosts  = ["*"]
runs   = ["open", "/usr/bin/plutil"]

[config]
place = "A folder to read"

[args.url]
ask  = "Which URL?"
pick = "url"

[args.to]
ask      = "Into which folder?"
vocab    = "places"
optional = true
